mainEntity.name: Why is electrical coordination important for my project in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Electrical coordination is vital for projects in Berkeley and the surrounding East Bay area to ensure the safety and reliability of the electrical system. Proper coordination prevents widespread power disruptions and equipment damage in the event of an electrical issue. This is especially important for commercial and industrial projects where downtime can be costly and safety is paramount.
